explication: AgentTeams is a Kubernetes-native multi-agent collaboration platform. A human or CLI submits declarative Manager, Team, Worker, and Human resources or project actions to the Controller API. Authentication and authorization protect the request; handlers persist or inspect state, while reconcilers converge teams and workers onto runtime backends, Matrix rooms, gateways, and shared storage. Workers then collaborate through Matrix and project workflows, with skills, files, checkpoints, and audit history exposed through APIs. This map preserves README capabilities; some integrations are represented only at directory level because their implementations were not sampled.
